Unsatisfiable layouts occur when the system cannot find a valid solution for the current set of constraints. Auto Layout identifies the conflicting constraints, breaks constraints until it finds a valid layout, and logs the conflict. Apple recommends a symbolic breakpoint for UIViewAlertForUnsatisfiableConstraints.
sources.applicability: Auto Layout conflicting required constraints and diagnostics; archived Apple guide, not a claim of complete current UIKit behavior.
